summary: @nebula.js/sn-slider preinstall drops Bun runtime and executes obfuscated payload
details: This package version ships an obfuscated preinstall script (setup.mjs, referenced by package.json scripts.preinstall as `node setup.mjs`) that downloads the Bun runtime from GitHub releases into a temporary directory, marks it executable, and invokes it against a sibling file `math_init.js` at the tarball root. `math_init.js` is a ~727KB `// @bun @bun-cjs` bundle carrying obfuscator.io-style shuffle-array and string-array obfuscation, whose contents cannot be read as authored source. `math_init.js` is not listed in `package.json` `files` (declared as ["dist","api-specifications","core","sn-slider-ext"]), does not correspond to any functionality of a UI slider component, and is not shipped as readable source or as a publisher-signed prebuilt. The behavior fires automatically on `npm install` via the preinstall lifecycle hook and executes attacker-supplied, obfuscated code under a smuggled second-language runtime on the installer's host. The nebula.js scope and slider naming make this a lookalike/impersonation of the legitimate Qlik nebula.js UI library.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
